Experience level: Intermediate. Description: Fetcherr builds responsible AI that transforms market complexity into measurable profit growth. At the core of the company is the Market Model - a proprietary AI-powered model delivering accurate, granular demand predictions with 96% forecast accuracy and real-time decision intelligence for commercial teams. Built on a glass-box architecture, it uses market data - not personal data - with full transparency into logic and outcomes. First deployed in global aviation, the technology is industry-agnostic and scales across volatile markets. Fetcherr delivers a consistent average profit uplift of 7%, with corporate partners including Delta, Virgin Atlantic, WestJet, Viva, and Azul. • The Price Optimization (PO) team is where insights become decisions. We work with large-scale customer data and market predictions — like demand forecasts — to drive revenue management decisions that actually move the needle. • At our core, we build and maintain the decision-making engine. That means designing the data pipelines that bring customer data in, and running it through an optimization engine that simulates the market — weighing competition, pricing constraints, inventory availability, predictive models, and each client's unique business policies — to generate the best possible price recommendations. As the final step before recommendations reach the client, quality, reliability, and attention to detail aren't just nice to have. They're everything. • We are looking for a Data Science Engineer to design and implement the decision-making logic of our Price Optimizer. You will focus on translating complex business rules into mathematical models and production-ready Python code. • Your primary mission is to build the "brain" of our system. You will work at the intersection of Data Science and Product, ensuring our simulation and optimization engines accurately reflect real-world pricing strategies and market dynamics. While you will write production code, you will rely on our Data Engineers for ETL pipelines orchestration and distributed compute scaling. • Responsibilities : • Implement Business Logic: Translate intricate pricing rules and commercial strategies into robust Python code and mathematical constraints. • Refine Optimization Models: Develop and tune the simulation and revenue management algorithms that drive our pricing recommendations. • Write Clean Code: Contribute high-quality, tested, and maintainable code to the core logic repositories. • Analyze & Improve: Use data to validate model behavior and identify edge cases where business rules clash with algorithmic outputs. • Collaborate: Partner with Solution Architects to define logic requirements and with Data Engineers to integrate your models into the Dagster pipelines. • Requirements: • 3+ years of experience in Data Science or Algorithmic Development with Python. • Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into code and logical rules. • Strong background in Mathematical Optimization, Simulation, or Logic Programming. • Fluency in the PyData stack (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and SQL • Experience writing production-quality code (not just notebooks) - you understand modular design and unit testing. • Familiarity with orchestration frameworks like Dagster or Airflow (from a user/logic perspective). • BSc/MSc in Mathematics/ physics/ statistics/ Computer Science. • Nice to Have: • Experience in Revenue Management, Air Travel, or Logistics domains. • Understanding of Derivative-Free Optimization. • Clickhouse •

What you’ll need

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Science or Algorithmic Development with Python
  • Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into code and logical rules
  • Strong background in Mathematical Optimization, Simulation, or Logic Programming
  • Fluency in the PyData stack (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and SQL
  • Experience writing production-quality code (not just notebooks) - you understand modular design and unit testing
  • Familiarity with orchestration frameworks like Dagster or Airflow (from a user/logic perspective)
  • BSc/MSc in Mathematics/ physics/ statistics/ Computer Science
  • Experience in Revenue Management, Air Travel, or Logistics domains plus
  • Understanding of Derivative-Free Optimization plus
  • Clickhouse plus

Data Analyst – Product Data & AI Quality • Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel • Similarweb is the leading digital intelligence platform used by over 3500 global customers. Our wide range of solutions power the digital strategies of companies like Google, eBay, and Adidas. • We help our customers succeed in today’s digital world by giving them access to data-driven insights, competitive benchmarks, strategic analysis, and more. • In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we haven’t stopped growing since! • We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our R&D department! • Why is this role so important at Similarweb? • Our Retail Intelligence products help leading brands and retailers understand how their products, brands and categories perform online. We use LLMs and ML models to classify, normalize and structure that data into a single, trusted view. • As a Data Analyst on the team, you’ll be the person who knows this data best. You’ll own its quality: defining what “correct” looks like, building the ground truth our models are measured against, and finding where things break and why. You’ll work closely with the engineers and scientists who build our LLM and ML pipelines, and with Product, turning what you find into clear priorities. Your work will also directly support our customers: partnering with our customer-facing teams on deep-dive analyses, and investigating and fixing the data gaps that matter most to clients. • It’s a role for someone curious and hands-on, who enjoys digging into data, uses AI tools to move faster, and wants to see their analysis directly shape the product. • So, what will you be doing all day? • Your daily responsibilities may include: • Analyzing product, brand and category data to find gaps, errors and opportunities to improve coverage and accuracy • Defining quality metrics and building the dashboards and checks that track them over time • Building and maintaining ground-truth datasets and labeling guidelines, and running labeling processes • Evaluating the output of LLM and ML models: error analysis, comparing approaches, and turning findings into concrete improvements • Using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analysis, labeling and data review • Helping define and maintain taxonomies and classification rules together with Product • Supporting client-related needs with our customer-facing teams, from in-depth analyses of specific market segments to investigating and fixing data gaps raised by clients • Validating new data sources before they are added to the product • Partnering with Product and engineering to translate findings into requirements and priorities • This is the perfect job for someone who: • Holds a B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or another quantitative field • Has 2+ years of experience as a data analyst, preferably in a tech company • Has strong SQL skills • Uses Python for data analysis (pandas, notebooks) - ABOUT PLACER.AI: • Placer.ai is transforming how organizations understand the physical world. Our location analytics platform provides unprecedented visibility into locations, markets, and consumer behavior. Placer empowers thousands of customers—from Fortune 500 companies, to local governments and nonprofits— to make smarter, data-driven decisions. • What sets us apart? We've built the most advanced location intelligence platform in the market while maintaining an uncompromising commitment to privacy, proving that powerful analytics and responsible data practices can coexist. • Our growth reflects the market's demand: we reached $100M in annual recurring revenue within just 6 years of launching, achieved unicorn status with a $1B+ valuation in 2022, and continue to expand rapidly as one of North America's fastest-growing tech companies. We're creating a $100B+ market opportunity, and we're just getting started. • Named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers and a Deloitte Technology Fast 500 company, we're building a culture where innovation thrives, collaboration is the norm, and every team member contributes to reshaping how the world understands location. • SUMMARY: • The Data Quality team sits at the intersection of data, R&D, and the business. We investigate complex data questions, validate the quality and reliability of Placer’s data products, and help our customer-facing teams understand what the data is telling us - and, just as importantly, when something doesn’t make sense. • We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst who genuinely enjoys working with data. Someone who loves investigating, solving puzzles, opening a dataset just to see what’s inside, and doesn’t stop at finding what happened but wants to understand why it happened. • A big part of the job is hands-on investigation in Databricks - writing code, creating notebooks, exploring large datasets, testing hypotheses, and following the data until you understand the story behind it. Morning is seeking a Business Product Analyst - a business-minded analyst who will work hand in hand with our Product Managers and Scrum teams as a true Business Partner. This is not a reporting or dashboard role. Your mission is to help the product teams deeply understand how our features are used by our customers, what value they create, and how they can make money. You will turn product and business data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that shape what the company builds, how it is measured, and how it is monetized. In a world where AI can surface data, this role exists to answer the harder business questions: Who uses this feature and why? Is it creating value? And how can it make money? כבר לא מקבלים בקשות Healthcare Data Analyst About the Company Antidote Health is a tech- driven health insurance company on a mission to make healthcare easy, accessible, and more affordable. We’re rethinking how healthcare works—using technology to remove the friction, complexity, and delays that define the traditional system. Instead of navigating paperwork, long waits, and disconnected experiences, we’re building a simpler, more connected way for people to get care. Our platform combines health coverage, virtual care, and a modern member experience into one seamless system designed to help people actually use their benefits. We offer Affordable Care Act (ACA) health plans in Arizona and Ohio, and we’re growing quickly. We’re building a company focused on solving real problems—with real impact on people’s lives. Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Healthcare Data Analyst to join our Data department and help turn complex healthcare data into clear, actionable insights that improve business performance, member experience, operational efficiency, and healthcare outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with curiosity about how healthcare works, together with the ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively in both English and Hebrew, verbally and in writing. This includes explaining the story behind the numbers, translating analysis into clear and actionable messages, and supporting stakeholder decision-making through discussions, reports, and presentations as needed. You will work closely with business, medical, operations, finance, product, and technology teams, using data from areas such as Healthplan M embership, Medical Claims, Providers, medical Utilization, and customer interactions . A successful Healthcare Data Analyst does more than produce reports. You understand the business question behind the request, determine which data can answer it, challenge questionable assumptions, validate the results, and turn the analysis into a clear recommendation or decision. You will help us build a culture where data is trusted, understood, and used to drive action . Perform ad-hoc analyses supporting strategic and operational decisions. Validate data quality and identify inconsistencies, missing data, or potential data pipeline issues. Work with data engineering and analytics teams to improve data models and reporting infrastructure. Support regulatory, operational, and management reporting when needed. Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications Required: 5+ years of experience in data analysis, healthcare intelligence, or a similar analytical role. Strong Python and SQL skills and experience working with large datasets. Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau or similar. Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift. Strong analytical thinking and ability to break ambiguous business questions into structured analyses. Ability to communicate insights clearly and explain the story behind the numbers Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple business functions. Master’s degree (with thesis) in a quantitative field such as Neurobiology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Public Health, or a related discipline. Preferred: Experience building or working with semantic layers and standardized metric definitions. Familiarity with US healthcare regulations and payer operations. Experience working in a fast-growing or highly cross-functional organization. Experience using AI tools to accelerate analytics, investigation, or reporting workflows. Parallel Wireless is reimagining mobile networks with innovative, energy-efficient Open RAN solutions. Join us as we lead the future of telecommunications, driving innovation through green and sustainable networks . Learn more about our mission, vision and values . We're hiring a Senior Data Scientist to own the non-real-time, ML-driven side of that system: turning large-scale network telemetry into models and analysis that make the entire platform smarter over time. You'll work directly on the algorithms that cluster cells, detect conflicts, and forecast load — and you'll partner closely with the real-time engineering team to push more of that intelligence into automated decision-making. Parallel Wireless is expanding the ecosystem for Open RAN with the GreenRAN™ energy-efficient Hardware-Agnostic technology. Deployed worldwide, our comprehensive 2G/3G/4G/5G Macro RAN solutions enhance network security while reducing operating expenses. As pioneers of Open RAN, we prioritize innovation, flexibility, and sustainability to help build a more connected, and green networks. Headquartered in the USA with global R&D centers, we are proud to serve over 60 customers worldwide and have been recognized with over 100 industry awards. Our mission is to accelerate GSMA’s Mobile Net Zero initiative by reducing TCO and driving innovation across the telecom ecosystem.Learn more at www.parallelwireless.com . Parallel Wireless embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams representing all backgrounds, with a wide range of perspectives, and empowering industry-leading skills. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.Parallel Wireless does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies or individuals. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Parallel Wireless employees, or any other company location. Parallel Wireless is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. What You'll Do: Design, build, and improve machine learning models and graph/statistical algorithms — including clustering, anomaly detection, and time-series modeling and forecasting — to drive automated network optimization. . Build a real, repeatable experimentation and model-deployment workflow (e.g., using MLflow or comparable tooling), taking models from notebook to production. Work directly with the near-real-time engineering team to identify where today's rule-based, threshold-driven decisions can be replaced by learned models that adapt to real network conditions. Mine large-scale time-series and topology data (stored in Elasticsearch, InfluxDB, and MongoDB) to uncover patterns in network behavior at the scale of thousands of cells and large user populations. Define and track quantitative success metrics so every model shipped can be proven to actually improve network outcomes, not just deployed and forgotten. Present findings and roadmap recommendations to engineering and business leadership. What We're Looking For: 5+ years of applied data science / machine learning experience, including graph algorithms, clustering, anomaly detection, or time-series modeling. Strong Python skills; comfort working alongside Go-based production services. Experience with large-scale time-series and document data stores (Elasticsearch, InfluxDB, MongoDB, or comparable). Experience with ML experiment tracking and deployment tooling (MLflow or equivalent) and with streaming data pipelines (Kafka or comparable). Excellent communication skills — the ability to turn open-ended "why is the network behaving this way" questions into a shipped, measurable model. Outstanding B.Sc . graduates in these fields may also be considered. M.Sc . in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or Software Engineering. Nice to Have: Background in telecom, RF, or wireless networking (handovers, KPIs such as RSRP or PRB utilization, cell topology). Experience turning a hand-tuned, rule-based system into a learned model running in a live production environment. Experience with distributed or streaming compute frameworks.

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years of applied data science / machine learning experience, including graph algorithms, clustering, anomaly detection, or time-series modeling
  • Strong Python skills; comfort working alongside Go-based production services
  • Experience with large-scale time-series and document data stores (Elasticsearch, InfluxDB, MongoDB, or comparable)
  • Experience with ML experiment tracking and deployment tooling (MLflow or equivalent) and with streaming data pipelines (Kafka or comparable)
  • Excellent communication skills — the ability to turn open-ended "why is the network behaving this way" questions into a shipped, measurable model
  • Outstanding B.Sc. graduates in these fields may also be considered
  • M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or Software Engineering
  • Background in telecom, RF, or wireless networking (handovers, KPIs such as RSRP or PRB utilization, cell topology) plus
  • Experience turning a hand-tuned, rule-based system into a learned model running in a live production environment plus
  • Experience with distributed or streaming compute frameworks plus

Solid product sense with the ability to translate product vision and features into actionable adoption and value metrics. Deep technical expertise in SQL and Python for advanced data analysis and data modeling. Hands-on experience building dashboards and analytical tools. Exceptional analytical thinking to identify trends, uncover friction points in user journeys, and translate complex data into clear business and product impact. Self-driven and proactive attitude, ready to own the domain, initiate processes, and inspire cross-functional teams. Advantage: Hands-on experience with data analytics platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflakes, etc). Advantage: Experience with event-based product analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude, FullStory, etc). Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The Role We're looking for a Head of Data to lead our Tel Aviv-based Data organization — spanning Data Infrastructure, Data Applications, and Data Adapters/Integration. This is a group-lead role: you will own the org's technical direction and delivery end to end, manage a group of Tech Leads and Staff Engineers (not just individual contributors), and be the single accountable owner for how Solidus ingests, stores, serves, and scales data across billions of events a day. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend real time in code, architecture reviews, and incident debugging — not just in planning meetings — and you'll be expected to be physically present and available as the standard for how the org operates. What you'll own Org leadership — manage and grow the Tech Leads and Staff Engineers running Data Infrastructure, Data Applications, and Data Adapters; set technical direction, hiring plans, and career paths for the group. Scale and reliability — guide decisions on our ClickHouse, Kafka, Airflow, and K8s-based pipelines processing billions of events a day across real-time and T+1 batch workloads; own migrations and technical-debt paydown (e.g., decommissioning legacy systems) with a concrete, tracked plan. End-to-end technical accountability — own architecture and detailed design decisions across the data stack; personally review critical PRs and lead debugging on high-severity production issues rather than delegating and disengaging. Delivery and quality — drive sprint delivery, on-call health, testing rigor, and code-review discipline across all three teams; be the last line of defense against regressions and breaking changes reaching production. Cross-functional and external representation — partner with Product, Compliance, Customer Success, and clients on integrations and data quality; represent the Data org professionally and constructively in stakeholder-facing conversations, including under pressure. Team development — mentor and coach Tech Leads and engineers, give and receive feedback directly and without defensiveness, and build clear upward paths for high performers. Requirements: What we're looking for 8+ years of backend/data engineering experience, including 3+ years managing multiple teams or leading through Tech Leads/Staff Engineers (not just individual contributors). Genuinely hands-on: Read and review code, help debug production issues personally, and go deep on a system rather than relying on secondhand summaries. Experience with high-throughput, low-latency data systems at scale: streaming (Kafka or similar), analytical stores (ClickHouse, Snowflake, or similar), orchestration (Airflow), and containerized microservices (K8s). Strong SQL and query optimization experience; comfort owning schema versioning, data governance, and deduplication strategy at scale. Proven track record of end-to-end ownership — architecture through implementation through operational health — with a demonstrated habit of catching issues (code review, testing, monitoring) before they reach production. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar) and owning operational SLAs. Demonstrated reliability and availability as a leadership default — consistent, predictable presence; transparent, advance planning of time off/travel rather than after-the-fact notice. Clear, professional written and verbal communication with both engineering and non-engineering/external stakeholders, including a demonstrated pattern of incorporating critical feedback without defensiveness. AI fist: coding tools/harnesses as part of a modern engineering workflow. Domain experience in fintech, trading, or crypto compliance/surveillance. Experience integrating third-party/customer data sources or leading vendor-facing technical relationships. Tech Stack Java, Kafka, ClickHouse, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes, Redis, AWS, Prometheus/Grafana. With AI seamlessly integrated into every workflow, entrepreneurs can focus on their craft while scaling their businesses with confidence. Since its founding in 2013, HoneyBook has powered over 25 million client relationships and processed more than $12 billion in transactions, helping independent businesses grow faster and smarter. Our culture is built on five core values that inform everything we do. We encourage collaboration, feedback, ownership, and maintain a growth mindset. We know experience comes in many forms - some visible on your resume, others not. No one candidate will be a 100% perfect match to our description, so if you thrive in a fast-paced, intellectually curious environment and have relevant experience, we encourage you to apply. We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join our Data Analytics team in Tel Aviv. You'll have a major impact on the products we build, owning analysis for one of HoneyBook's most strategic product areas- from mature, high-scale domains to newer bets still taking shape. You'll partner with stakeholders across different domains to turn ambiguous questions into decisions. You'll also take an active part in building and shaping the AI-powered tooling our team uses to scale how we work and enable data to the company. What we're looking for: - Sharp judgment. You dig deeper than what the data shows on the surface, you can tell a real pattern from noise, and identify real behavior. - Comfortable in ambiguity. You can take a high-level problem, break it down, and build the analysis approach and questions yourself. - Strong product and business instincts. You understand how a feature affects revenue, retention, or user behavior, not just what the dashboard says. - Clear, persuasive communicator. You can share an analysis, a finding, or a recommendation with senior stakeholders clearly enough that they act on it. - Constantly pushes AI into the workflow. You look for where AI can save time and improve results, and you build it yourself. - Technical rigor. You design and run rigorous analyses and experiments, and you catch your own mistakes before anyone else does. - High ownership. If it's your problem, you solve it. Keep it real: Authenticity, respect, and transparency are at our core. The opportunity at HoneyBook is huge. As Senior BI Analyst, you own that last mile: the BI platform everyone opens to answer their questions, and the KPI definitions that make sure the numbers on every dashboard mean the same thing across every team. This is the business-facing anchor of our analytics function. You'll build and govern the reporting layer, define the metrics that leadership runs the company on, and lead the Business Analyst guild — the network of domain analysts embedded across GTM, Finance, CS, and Product. You're equal parts platform owner, metrics authority, and enabler of the analysts around you. Description Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Static Timing Analysis (STA) Engineer to join our ASIC implementation team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in timing analysis, timing closure, and signoff for complex SoC designs at advanced technology nodes. The engineer will work closely with RTL, Physical Design, DFT, and CAD teams to ensure successful timing convergence and tape-out. Key Responsibilities Own full-chip and block-level timing closure from synthesis through signoff. Perform static timing analysis across multiple operating modes and PVT corners. Develop, review, and maintain timing constraints (SDC). Analyze and resolve setup, hold, recovery, removal, clock gating, pulse width, and timing exception violations. Perform SI-aware timing analysis and crosstalk delay/noise debugging. Collaborate with Physical Design teams to optimize placement, CTS, routing, and ECO implementation for timing closure. Generate and validate timing ECOs while ensuring minimal impact on power, area, and functionality. Validate timing exceptions including false paths, multicycle paths, asynchronous paths, and generated clocks. Perform timing signoff using industry-standard EDA tools. Support timing correlation between implementation and signoff environments. Develop automation scripts to improve timing analysis and reporting. Participate in design reviews and provide technical guidance on timing-related issues. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to methodology improvements. Requirements Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in ASIC Static Timing Analysis or Physical Design. Strong understanding of: Static Timing Analysis fundamentals Timing constraints (SDC) MCMM timing analysis Clock tree architecture and clock propagation Signal Integrity (SI) OCV, AOCV, POCV, and SOCV methodologies CRPR and advanced variation modeling Liberty (.lib), SPEF, SDF, and Verilog formats Experience with advanced technology nodes (16nm, 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, or similar). Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills. Required Technical Skills Proficiency with STA and implementation tools such as: Synopsys PrimeTime Synopsys Fusion Cadence Innovus Cadence Tempus Synopsys StarRC Experience with Linux/Unix environments. Strong scripting skills in Tcl and Shell; familiarity with Perl or Python is preferred. Experience with version control systems such as Git. Preferred Qualifications Experience with hierarchical and full-chip timing signoff. Experience with timing signoff automation and methodology development. Understanding of synthesis, place-and-route, and physical implementation flows. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Attention to detail and commitment to design quality. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership. What You'll Bring Ownership of timing closure for complex ASIC or SoC designs. Ability to drive timing signoff independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams. Expertise in advanced timing methodologies, SI-aware analysis, MCMM signoff, and ECO execution. A proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement, automation, and delivering successful tape-outs.

HoneyBook is the leading AI-powered business management platform for service-based business owners. Designed to enhance - not replace - independent professionals. HoneyBook’s AI-powered tools help businesses attract leads, connect with clients, book projects, and manage payments more efficiently. With AI seamlessly integrated into every workflow, entrepreneurs can focus on their craft while scaling their businesses with confidence. Since its founding in 2013, HoneyBook has powered over 25 million client relationships and processed more than $12 billion in transactions, helping independent businesses grow faster and smarter. Our culture is built on five core values that inform everything we do. We encourage collaboration, feedback, ownership, and maintain a growth mindset. We know experience comes in many forms - some visible on your resume, others not. No one candidate will be a 100% perfect match to our description, so if you thrive in a fast-paced, intellectually curious environment and have relevant experience, we encourage you to apply. We are on the search for a Marketing Analytics Lead who will join our Data team in Tel Aviv. As a Marketing Analytics Lead in a Data-Driven company, you will have a significant opportunity for impact and drive the company to new heights. You will influence decision-making processes throughout marketing budget decisions, new user journeys, be a partner to cross-functional teams within data, marketing & Top of Funnel, and drive strategic business decisions that shape the direction of the company. Here are a few of the things you will do: Own end-to-end analytics for marketing and product growth initiatives, directly supporting business strategy and growth, including and not limited to acquisition, lifecycle, and user onboarding. Act as the primary data owner for the planning, monitoring, and measuring a variety of marketing initiatives, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and trust in decision-making across stakeholders, enabling your stakeholders to learn from data and iterate with confidence. Translate complex datasets from multiple sources into clear, actionable insights with measurable business impact. Proactively initiate and perform ad hoc research and deep-dive analyses to surface unknown business opportunities to inform strategic and operational decisions. Partner with marketing, product, finance and company leadership to drive cross-functional, data-driven outcomes. Design, improve, and scale analytics infrastructure, data pipelines, and workflows to suit your analytics needs; work hands-on using tools such as SQL, DBT, Looker, and partner closely with Data Engineering and Data Science teams. Design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests using rigorous statistical methods and well-defined KPIs, including ownership of appropriate KPI selection. Present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders with clarity and influence, through written communication, presentations, and via dashboards. Contribute expertise to shared analytics standards, best practices, and knowledge forums (e.g., Data Guild). Interested? Here's what we're looking for: 3+ years of experience in data analytics roles with expert SQL skills and data visualization tools - Looker, Tableau, PBI, Omni, etc. 2+ years of experience working in the marketing data analytics field. Proven track record collaborating with teams to leverage data-driven insights to improve performance. You have a bias towards action; you don’t wait for someone to tell you what to do and are comfortable working with ambiguity. You don’t stop once you pull the data; you love turning numbers into actionable insights. You’re a strong communicator and have an art for communicating complex findings in a simple way. Your thinking is structured, and you have excellent intuition for numbers and data. And most importantly, you believe in HoneyBook’s mission and know how you will contribute to our success. The good stuff: Mission-driven: You'll be joining more than just another startup. Our members’ success is at the heart of everything we do. Impact: We move quickly and encourage every employee to push the envelope. Our best ideas come from out-of-the-box thinking and innovation; be ready to fail fast and often! Compensation: We offer a competitive salary and meaningful equity grants. Benefits & perks: From wellness programs to exceptional family leave policies, the health and happiness of our employees are foremost. Our core values: People come first: We prioritize people as we explore opportunities and work through challenges. Raise the bar: We push for greatness—for ourselves, each other, and our members. Own it: Trust and ownership let us make decisions with confidence. We love what we do: We bring passion to our work and love what we create for our members. Keep it real: Authenticity, respect, and transparency are at our core. The opportunity at HoneyBook is huge. Our primary customers today are creative businesses that generate $150M in revenue per year in the US. Founded in 2013, HoneyBook is based in San Francisco and Tel Aviv, has raised $498M, and is funded by Tiger Global Management, Norwest Venture Partners, Aleph, Hillsven Capital, OurCrowd, Durable Capital Partners LP, Vintage Investment Partners, Battery Ventures, Citi Ventures, Zeev Ventures, and 01 Advisors. Follow us on LinkedIn , BuiltIn and Instagram to catch the latest stories about HoneyBook. Company Description At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation. Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen. This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems. We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture. What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely. If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it. Job Description About the Role Numbers tell stories. Compensation tells even better stories. We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly motivated Compensation & Benefits Analyst to join our Global Compensation & Benefits team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who loves working with data, enjoys solving puzzles, and wants to learn how global organizations make decisions about employee pay, benefits, rewards, and workforce strategy. You don't need to be a compensation expert yet - we will teach you that part. What we're really looking for is someone who gets excited about Excel formulas, asks "why?" more often than most people, and isn't afraid to dive into large datasets until they reveal their secrets. (Warning: prolonged exposure to this role may result in unexpectedly strong opinions about salary structures, market data, and pivot tables.) What You'll Do As part of our Global Compensation & Benefits team, you will: Compensation Analytics & Benchmarking Participate in salary benchmarking projects using leading market surveys and compensation databases. Analyze internal and external compensation data to support competitive and equitable pay decisions. Assist with the maintenance of salary ranges, job architecture, and compensation frameworks. Support annual compensation cycles, including merit reviews, promotions, and salary adjustments. Conduct compensation analyses and help prepare recommendations for managers and HR partners. Data, Reporting & Insights Partner with HR Operations on data management in the HR system (HRDB) - including uploads, audits, and ongoing maintenance of HR data - to safeguard data integrity across the employee lifecycle. Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and analyses using Excel, Power BI, and HR systems. Translate complex data into simple and actionable insights. Support pay equity, workforce planning, and regulatory reporting initiatives. Benefits & Total Rewards Assist in the evaluation and administration of employee benefits programs. Conduct market research and trend analysis on benefits and total rewards practices. Support communication efforts to help employees understand our rewards programs. Business Partnership Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders on compensation-related initiatives. Contribute to projects that improve processes, governance, and the employee experience. Continuous Improvement Look for smarter, faster, and more efficient ways to work. Leverage AI and technology tools to enhance reporting, analyses, and decision-making. Bring fresh ideas and challenge existing assumptions. This is a temporary position for 3 months Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Psychology, Business Administration, Human Resources, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced Excel skills or a strong willingness to become an Excel wizard. High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Excellent communication skills in English. Curiosity, ownership, and a growth mindset. Nice to Have Familiarity with compensation, benefits, finance, payroll, or HR analytics. Experience using AI tools to improve productivity and analysis. Basic knowledge of statistics and data visualization. Who Will Thrive in This Role? You might be a great fit if: You enjoy working with numbers as much as people. You get genuine satisfaction from finding an error that nobody else noticed. You ask thoughtful questions instead of accepting things at face value. You can explain a complicated analysis in language that normal humans understand. You view "I've never done that before" as an exciting opportunity rather than a problem. What You'll Learn This role offers a unique opportunity to build expertise in: Global compensation strategy Salary benchmarking and market intelligence Pay equity and regulatory compliance Executive and broad-based compensation programs Benefits design and governance Advanced people analytics Business partnering and stakeholder management You'll work closely with experienced Compensation & Benefits professionals and gain exposure to strategic projects that have a direct impact on thousands of employees worldwide. Final Note We're not looking for someone who already knows everything about Compensation & Benefits. We're looking for someone who is excited to learn everything about Compensation & Benefits. If you're naturally curious, analytical, driven, and ready to grow - we'd love to meet you. Bring your curiosity. We'll teach you the compensation part. Additional Information

  • Advanced Excel skills or a strong willingness to become an Excel wizard
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

כבר לא מקבלים בקשות THE ROLE We are looking for a Trading & Market Operations Analyst to support G Coin’s trading, treasury, and exchange operations across centralized and decentralized digital-asset exchanges. The role focuses on monitoring market conditions and liquidity, executing authorized transactions in accordance with internal policies, reconciling exchange and wallet balances, working closely with exchanges and external market makers, and identifying unusual market activity and operational risks. RESPONSIBILITIES Monitor G Coin activity across supported centralized and decentralized exchanges. Analyze trading volumes, spreads, order-book depth, liquidity, volatility, and market concentration. Execute authorized trading and treasury transactions within established limits and approval procedures. Monitor exchange and wallet balances and ensure accurate reconciliation of transactions and holdings. Coordinate operational matters with exchanges, external market makers, and other liquidity providers. Monitor and assess external market makers against agreed KPIs, service levels, contractual requirements, and market-integrity standards. Review market-maker reports and independently verify relevant trading and liquidity data. Identify and escalate unusual trading patterns, potential market abuse, operational anomalies, and liquidity risks. Prepare regular reports on market activity, liquidity conditions, balances, transactions, market-maker performance, and identified risks. Support exchange listings, trading-pair launches, wallet integrations, deposits, withdrawals, and related operational processes. Maintain complete records of transactions, approvals, communications, and account activity. Ensure that all activities comply with internal controls, exchange rules, applicable requirements, and market-integrity standards. REQUIREMENTS 1–3 years of experience in trading operations, treasury, financial-market analysis, brokerage, digital assets, or a related field. Practical understanding of cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets. Experience working with centralized and decentralized exchanges. Understanding of order books, liquidity, spreads, volatility, trading volume, and market risk. Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and market data. Proficiency in using AI tools for market research, data analysis, reporting, and workflow automation. High level of accuracy, integrity, responsibility, and discretion. Ability to follow defined authorization procedures and maintain clear transaction records. Strong written and spoken English. ADVANTAGES Experience working with or overseeing external market makers or liquidity providers. Experience with a digital-asset company, exchange, broker, fintech company, or treasury function. Familiarity with on-chain analytics, wallets, token bridges, and blockchain transactions. Experience identifying unusual market activity, potential manipulation, or compliance risks.

What you’ll need

  • 1–3 years of experience in trading operations, treasury, financial-market analysis, brokerage, digital assets, or a related field
  • Practical understanding of cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets
  • Experience working with centralized and decentralized exchanges
  • Understanding of order books, liquidity, spreads, volatility, trading volume, and market risk
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and market data
  • Proficiency in using AI tools for market research, data analysis, reporting, and workflow automation
  • High level of accuracy, integrity, responsibility, and discretion
  • Ability to follow defined authorization procedures and maintain clear transaction records
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Experience working with or overseeing external market makers or liquidity providers plus
  • Experience with a digital-asset company, exchange, broker, fintech company, or treasury function plus
  • Familiarity with on-chain analytics, wallets, token bridges, and blockchain transactions plus
  • Experience identifying unusual market activity, potential manipulation, or compliance risks plus

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the role As we scale and evolve our fully automated fraud prevention strategies, we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our growing Fraud Analytics team. We operate in a data-rich, fast-paced environment, processing billions of data points annually, and play a critical role in safeguarding large enterprises from fraud. In this role, you will work at the intersection of data analysis, fraud strategy, and automation, collaborating closely with engineering, data science, and commercial teams to develop scalable fraud detection solutions. Description We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our core team and own the data, reporting, and insight layer that our biggest decisions are built on — what to greenlight, what to spend, and where to double down. You'll report into the Head of Data and work closely with Marketing, Product, and Content, but the core of the job is data work: querying, modeling, dashboarding, and rigorous analysis. As we scale, so will your scope — this is a launchpad role, not a fixed lane. Responsibilities Reporting & Dashboards: Own end-to-end reporting — build, maintain, and improve dashboards (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) — and ensure the pipelines feeding them are accurate, timely, and well-documented. Analysis & Insight Generation: Turn raw data into clear, actionable recommendations by analyzing funnels and attribution, tracking core KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROAS, retention), and proactively surfacing opportunities rather than waiting to be asked. Data Integration & Engineering: Define and validate tables and data models, define BI events and tracking specs with product and engineering, and work closely with the data engineering team to keep data clean, unified, and query-ready across analytics, ad/campaign, CRM, and product data sources. Experimentation: Support or run A/B tests across campaigns, product features, or content, applying statistical rigor to test design and readouts. Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex data into clear narratives for non-technical stakeholders, and present findings with a structured, problem-first point of view rather than just executing requests as asked. Requirements B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering/Economics/Statistics, or equivalent degree 4+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role. Strong SQL and hands-on experience with BigQuery, Presto, or similar large-scale databases/warehouses. Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar). Experience building tables/data models and defining BI events, ideally in partnership with data engineering. Experience working with digital data sources (e.g., Google Analytics, ad platforms, CRM systems). Solid grasp of funnels, attribution modeling, and core performance KPIs. Able to communicate complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders. High attention to detail; structured, problem-solving mindset. Huge Advantages Background in mobile / gaming / short-form content or other high-velocity B2C products. Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, including statistical significance.

What you’ll need

  • B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering/Economics/Statistics, or equivalent degree
  • 4+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role
  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience with BigQuery, Presto, or similar large-scale databases/warehouses
  • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Experience building tables/data models and defining BI events, ideally in partnership with data engineering
  • Experience working with digital data sources (e.g., Google Analytics, ad platforms, CRM systems)
  • Solid grasp of funnels, attribution modeling, and core performance KPIs
  • Able to communicate complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • High attention to detail; structured, problem-solving mindset
  • Background in mobile / gaming / short-form content or other high-velocity B2C products
  • Experience designing and evaluating A/B tests, including statistical significance

About The Position Vi is the market-leading Enterprise-AI platform for health, serving some of the world’s largest health organizations—from Fortune 500 healthcare providers to pharma and consumer brands—helping them maximize acquisition, enrollment, engagement, retention, and health outcomes. Vi’s platform is backed by $125M+ in R&D, serving over 175 million members daily and growing. We operate across New York, Austin, Nashville, and Tel Aviv and are looking for a talented Business Analyst to join our team. We are looking for a talented Data Analyst that will play a crucial part of the product team, leading the continuous growth and improvement of the most important product that powers Vi’s success. As a Business analyst, you will ensure that our data and insights are actionable to drive decisions across the business and communicate data-driven insights and recommendations to key stakeholders at all levels. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical, and analytical sense and can communicate meaningful, actionable insights in a clear and concise manner. Responsibilities Be the focal point in terms of data familiarity, business goals and KPIs in a data-centric company Help promote a “data-driven culture” with all stakeholders, both internally and externally. Proactively perform data analysis that yields recommendations for improving our models, and campaigns and also surface new opportunities. Attend customer-facing meetings and convey data insights in a clear and informative manner See beyond numbers and help to inform, influence, support and execute our business decisions Build reports, dashboards and metrics, in addition to monitoring the integrity and validity of the data reported Be a trusted partner for executive management to ensure program success. Conduct user segmentation/churn prediction/funnel optimization and LTV analysis by manipulating Vi’s data sets. Build ROI models Provide essential visibility of our data to multiple stakeholders: Product Managers, Commercial team, and Engineering by developing and maintaining meaningful and actionable dashboards. Identify Medical/Clinical gaps in Vi offering when approaching specific markets and recommend methods to address them (white papers, publications, etc’). Requirements 3+ years of experience in making analytical, data-driven decisions and communicating the results to key stakeholders – preferably in SaaS companies 3+ years of experience manipulating data sets using SQL Experience with visualization tools (preferable Tableau) 3+ years of experience working collaboratively with different stakeholders Ability to think strategically, analyze and interpret product behavioral data to grow the business Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hebrew Strong data storytelling abilities Bachelor’s Degree in a data-related field – Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Math, Computer Science, Business etc. Advantages A passion for technology and for learning Knowledge in Python Experience in data analysis and visualization using Python Why choose VI At Vi we provide you with the autonomy to deliver, the safety to make mistakes and the opportunity to help millions of people live happier and healthier lives. We believe that building a great product and a great company starts with finding amazing people and helping them grow and develop professionally and personally. At Vi, you’ll be surrounded by curious, witty, and passionate people that are hungry to drive real impact.
